name: Waltz walking bass
desc: 3/4 walking bass in Ab major - a new key for the walking shelf: three-to-the-bar quarter walk through a I-vi-ii-V waltz turnaround with skips and chromatic approaches, dotted-half pedal points in sparse, double-time triplet fills at peak.

root.doc: semitone offset from Ab major home

code.full: note("<[ab1 c2 eb2] [f1 ab1 c2] [bb1 db2 f2] [eb2 db2 g1] [ab1 eb2 c2] [f2 e2 c2] [bb1 f2 ab2] [eb2 bb1 e1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.01).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.15).shape(.28).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.75, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).clip(.9).gain(${gain}).room(.25).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply("1 1 2")).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[ab1 c2 eb2] [f1 ab1 c2] [bb1 db2 f2] [eb2 [db2 c2] g1] [ab1 eb2 c2] [f2 e2 c2] [bb1 [f2 g2] ab2] [eb2 bb1 e1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.5).slow(8)).lpq(3).attack(.006).decay(.18).sustain(.3).release(.1).shape(.32).clip(.88).gain(${gain}).room(.22).every(4, x=>x.ply("1 1 2")).orbit(3).play()
